scientific_limitations: Only principal restrictions to two distinct linear lines through the origin in the standard nondegenerate bilinear plane are classified; arbitrary affine and rectangular masks are not addressed. Computational tests cover eleven finite fields, while generality rests on proof. Earlier rank-character-block analysis is credited, and equivalent quantitative historical work may exist.
title: Sharp finite-field two-line Fourier conditioning and a golden-ratio stability gap
